title: Unmasking Hidden Wigner's Symmetry from First Principles
summary: We present quantitative evidence that high-quality internucleon forces derived from $χ$EFT exhibit a striking dominance of Wigner's supermultiplet symmetry, without invoking the large-$N_c$ limit of QCD or assumptions about specific nuclei. We trace the manifestation of this symmetry in nuclear structure using the ab initio Symmetry Adapted Model (SAM) and identify suppressed spin-isospin polarizability.
